inventory.selection_note: Skip the just-reviewed SPEEDZ and CAMP work, and skip unresolved-identity candidate clusters for this pass. Select the next exact published-build fields with a specific target and plausible direct manufacturer, retailer, or mainland price route.

scope.research_boundary: One Luna Max evidence-only reviewer; root is sole writer. Work sequentially, one exact model and source at a time. For each field allow one newly discovered direct exact-model source/page, then stop. Inspect each predecessor research-attempt file and do not repeat any URL, query, or route already recorded there. The agent reports source title, publisher/class, exact URL, access date, supported fact, exact size/build/market basis, caveat, and whether it qualifies. No agent file writes.
claim_rules: Complete weight must apply to the exact Falath R7170 build and state size/equipment basis when the source gives one; a frameset mass is not a complete-bike weight.
Tire clearance must be a maximum for the exact model/build; fitted tire size alone does not establish the maximum.
Frame weights must be frame-only, with stated size/paint/accessory basis; do not use complete-bike mass or transfer neighboring trims.
Geometry must be readable numeric exact-frame data with size mapping; do not infer coordinates from sizing labels or images that cannot be read reliably.

Mainland price evidence must identify the exact frameset option and observation date, preserve price conditions, and be a mainland-market listing or checkout basis; reject export, wholesale, or unrelated complete-bike prices.
Bottom-bracket evidence must name the S8 shell standard or dimensions for the exact platform/build; crank family does not establish the frame shell.
A purchase route must be current, public, exact-build, and directly actionable; a search card without a usable exact item route or blocked risk page does not qualify.
excluded: No XHS, Weibo, login, CAPTCHA, challenge handling, account access, seller contact, purchase, cart, quote, external message, image download/rehosting, source write, or catalog write.
Do not open any result_url already recorded in the scoped predecessor attempts. Avoid duplicate or sibling-model pages even if a search result ranks them highly.

Stop on an inaccessible page, identity ambiguity, wrong market, non-exact build, or missing decision-critical measurement basis; preserve the field as unknown/conflicted rather than searching another source.
